text:
Clara: quick thread  we need to finalize the send plan for the benchmark newsletter but also lock the blackout windows and seedlist rules. noticed some recent ISP throttles last quarter.
Diego: ok. main asks: 1) personalization tokens & fallbacks 2) blackout (do-not-send) windows for EU privacy hours 3) seedlist composition + monitoring thresholds.
Mei: personalization tokens: we'll use {{first_name}}, {{company_name}}, {{plan_tier}}. fallback rules: if first_name null -> use 'there', if company_name null -> 'your team', if tier null -> 'your account'. Also tokenized deep links: https://console.redwood.ai/start?uid={{user_id}} (ensure signed tokens for security).
Raj: legal/compliance: for EU users we must check consent flag gdpr_consent = true. Also for CA/CPRA include ca_opt_in = true. Add suppression for users with marketing_consent = false.
Diego: blackout windows: define global: 22:00-06:00 local send time suppressed. For EU localized blackout add 13:00-14:00 CET (system maintenance window). For APAC avoid 07:30-09:00 local (commute spike). Also special blackout for partner contacts and previously flagged do_not_contact windows.
Clara: seedlist: 200 addresses across ISPs + internal + partners. split by provider: Gmail 60, Outlook 50, Apple 40, Yahoo 20, regional ISPs 30. include 20 monitoring addresses with AMP/SPF checks.
Mei: monitoring thresholds: immediate pause if spam complaints > 0.05% first wave OR hard bounces > 0.3%. Soft rule: if open rate < 1% in first 3h for a slice, throttle that slice. Also check ISP-specific delivery delays > 2h.
Raj: SQL for segmentation + consent filter (example infra cohort):
```
SELECT email FROM users
WHERE role IN ('infra','platform')
  AND last_active > now() - interval '180 days'
  AND marketing_consent = true
  AND gdpr_consent = true
  AND unsubscribed = false;
```
Diego: dynamic content blocks: show 'Dedicated customers' snippet if dedicated_customer = true. else show 'Get the benchmark report'. For promo banner, only show for plan_tier IN ('pro','enterprise').
Clara: subject personalization test: A) "{first_name}, see the benchmark numbers" vs B) "New benchmark: throughput and cost results". We'll only run name-personalized subject in cohorts with first_name present to avoid odd blanks. Preheader variants: short vs descriptive.
Mei: tracking & UTMs: utm_campaign=benchmark_seed_personalize, utm_medium=email, utm_content={segment}_{subject_variant}. Add event tags: nl_open, nl_click, nl_register, token_click. For token links ensure we map user_id to hashed id in analytics to avoid PII.
Raj: deliverability ops: ramp plan 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% over 20h to be gentle. Use custom return-path, ensure DKIM alignment and SPF. If ISP returns greylist for >50% of one provider, pause and re-evaluate.
Diego: QA checklist specific to tokens: 1) render with missing tokens (seed addresses) to confirm fallbacks 2) test deep link auth fallback (invalid token -> safe landing page) 3) test localized date/time for calendar .ics 4) check image alt text.
Clara: timeline: copy freeze Tue noon, tokens templated Wed AM, DF pull Wed night, QA Thu morning, seed wave Fri, full ramp Sat local windows. Mei: can you prepare a 20-address test set with null tokens to ensure fallbacks?
Mei: yes will prepare null-token seeds + regional testboxes. Also will add a test to validate consent gating.
Diego: reporting: dashboard to show by-provider deliverability, seed opens, spam complaints, unsub rates, and token error rate (token_error events).
Clara: final small asks: include a one-line fallback in email for text-only clients: 'View this email in your browser: https://redwood.ai/newsletters/1769990123' and ensure link is not tokenized.
PreviewBot: staging preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/newsletters/1769990123-preview - mobile + desktop snapshots attached.
Raj: locking these rules. Clara will consolidate into the newsletter brief and attach send checklist.
Clara: thanks team  will post the brief here when ready.
Diego: thanks all.
PreviewBot: campaign job scheduled (id 9001).
